cv_text: Candidate for DevOps Engineer. Skills: Terraform, AWS, CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: Welcome. Tell me about your experience as a DevOps Engineer.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: I have several years building devops engineer systems with Terraform and AWS. Recently I led a project improving throughput using CI/CD.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: Describe a hard problem you solved and the trade-offs you weighed.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: We hit a scaling bottleneck; I profiled it, isolated the hot path, and redesigned it with Kubernetes. The trade-off was added complexity, justified by a 4x latency win.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.content_text: How do you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.content_text: I frame decisions around user impact and cost, use diagrams, and confirm understanding by restating the agreed plan.
